title: claude-code fetch_analytics_user_cost
description: A JSON array of every cost row for one user, one daily bucket and one product, each row stored verbatim from GET /v1/organizations/analytics/user_cost_report. The connector checks actor.user_id and starting_at; the other properties are typed from the vendor's documentation.

items.description: One cost row. The vendor fans a bucket out by model, cost_type and token_type.

user_id.description: Anthropic user id. Part of the ExternalID.

deleted.description: Whether the user has been deleted (vendor-documented).

starting_at.description: Bucket start, RFC 3339. Its UTC date is part of the ExternalID, and midnight UTC of that date is the DataDate.

product.description: Product the cost belongs to, such as claude_code or chat. Part of the ExternalID; absent, null or empty groups under unknown.

model.description: Model id or display name. Not part of the ExternalID (vendor-documented).

amount.description: Net cost as a decimal string in fractional cents: "41280.000000" is $412.80. Parse it as a decimal, not a float (vendor-documented).

list_amount.description: List-price cost, same encoding as amount (vendor-documented).

currency.description: ISO currency code, such as USD (vendor-documented).

cost_type.description: Kind of cost, such as tokens. Nullable (vendor-documented).

token_type.description: Token class for a tokens cost, such as output_tokens. Nullable (vendor-documented).

slack_channel_id.description: Slack channel for Claude-in-Slack cost, else null (vendor-documented).
